sources: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380105 (site detail pages for the 27 Manor Camping Area sites, read 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: parkreservations.maryland.gov site details for Manor sites M006, M009, M010, M018 ('Electrical Service (amp): 30'), read 2026-10-20; DNR: Manor Area '20 basic sites, 7 electric sites'

values.note: The Manor bathhouse (flush toilets, hot showers) is open only from the beginning of April to the last weekend in October; in winter only portable restrooms. Manor campers have free use of the William Houck Area dump station, April-October. Firewood for sale in season (exact cash).

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/cunningham.aspx (Manor Area Campground: 'Centrally located bathhouse with flushing toilets and hot showers (only available April-October)'; 'Free access to the William Houck Area dump station'; During Winter), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DNR: 'All Manor Area Campground reservations should be made using the park reservation website. Reservations should be made online in advance so that you can receive important alerts and be granted access into the campground ... Those without reservations will not be guaranteed access to the campground. Without a reservation, access will not be granted when park entrance gates are closed.' Phone reservations Monday-Friday 9-5. The booking site gives the Manor sites their own booking window, which it does not print.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/cunningham.aspx + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/cunningham-falls-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380105 (Booking Window: 'There are 7/20 site(s) in this category with different booking windows' listing M001-M031), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Manor Area: 20 basic sites (vehicle length 30 ft) and 7 electric sites (28 ft), no cabins; site pads list 24 x 24 ft. M009 is pull-through.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/cunningham.aspx ('20 basic sites, 7 electric sites, no cabins') + parkreservations.maryland.gov campsiteDetails for M001-M031 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed year-round Manor campground and fees as recorded (human-checked 2026-10-12). Added 30-amp electric, seasonal bathhouse with showers and flush toilets (April-October; portable toilets in winter), dump use at the Houck Area (not recorded as on-site), reservations through ReserveAmerica, 27 sites up to 30 ft with one pull-through. Not stated: water/sewer at sites, the Manor sites' booking window, minimum stay for this park, a clear first-come rule (walk-ups are 'not guaranteed access').
